text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Scarborough Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application by the owner(s) of 17 Benroyal Crescent to maintain a wooden fence in the front yard on the south side of the property that measures 1.9 meters (6.2 feet) and a wooden fence on the west side flankage yard that measures 2.1 meters (6.8 feet) which exceed the maximum allowable height of 1.2 meters (3.9 feet) for a front yard fence and 2.0 meters (6.5 feet) on the flankage yard. as specified in the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447-1.2B(1) Table 1 - Maximum Height of Fences. A Notice of Violation was issued on September 6, 2022. The applicant has requested this exemption for security and privacy for his young children.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Granted the application for an exemption permit, by the owner(s) of 17 Benroyal Crescent, to allow them to maintain the wooden fence in the front yard on the south side of the property that measures 1.9 meters (6.2 feet) and a wooden fence on the west side flankage yard that measures 2.1 meters (6.8 feet) which exceed the maximum allowable height of 1.2 meters (3.9 feet) for a front yard fence and 2.0 meters (6.5 feet) on the flankage yard. Directed and required that the existing fence be maintained in good repair without alteration. Directed and required that at such time as a replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences or its successor by-law.
